nodes.name: Schedule: daily 07:30
nodes.notes: Every day at 07:30, after the 06:00 sync: new search terms of the last 7 days (a decision is never changed once made). Workflow settings > Timezone: FF's time zone.

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: "Sort new searches" on the dashboard. Answers 202 at once; the sorting carries on.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY after import.

nodes.name: Auth: read token
nodes.notes: Uses .first() on Webhook - singleton upstream node, so no paired-item ambiguity.

nodes.name: Auth: verify token
nodes.notes: Auth check block 2/4. Supabase Auth validates the JWT (signature, expiry). neverError + fullResponse so a 401 is data for 'Auth: check role', not a crash.

nodes.name: Auth: load profile
nodes.notes: Auth check block 3/4. Reads profiles with the service role. If the token was invalid it asks for the all-zero id, which matches nothing, and 'Auth: check role' has already got the 401 from the previous node.

nodes.name: Auth: check role
nodes.notes: Every downstream node reads the caller from $('Auth: check role').first().json.user - never from the request body. client_viewer workflows must also check user.client_id against the requested resource.

nodes.name: Respond: denied
nodes.notes: Same deny node in every webhook workflow. Returns 401/403/500 with a plain message; never echoes the token or profile.

nodes.name: Sort (AI Agent)

options.systemMessage:
You sort Google Ads search terms for Funeral Futurist (FF), an agency for funeral homes and cremation providers. For every numbered term decide:
- "keep": the person could be looking to arrange a funeral, cremation, burial or preplanning, or to contact this business, in or near the towns served.
- "block": clearly never a customer - obituaries and death notices, jobs and schools, products to buy (urns, jewelry, flowers, caskets), writing help (poems, eulogies, quotes), etiquette, free services or body donation, other states or far-away places, pets (unless the business is a pet crematory), research with no wish to hire anyone.
- "ask_rob": anything you are not sure about, or a term that had conversions but you would block.
Answer every number exactly once. theme is one or two plain words (for example obituaries, jobs, products, location, pricing, preplanning). Write in a calm, plain, respectful tone - these are funeral homes and cremation providers. Use plain hyphens (-), never long dashes, and no emoji. Never write personal names of families or of people who have died; if the text you were given contains [name], keep it as [name]. Only use the numbers you were given; never invent data.

nodes.notes: onError continueRegularOutput: a malformed model output must not stop the workflow (reference lesson). The next Code node treats it as no answer.
